title: Canada strikes back at Trump with retaliatory tariffs as US trade war escalates
summary: Canada on Tuesday announced retaliatory tariffs on C$27.6 billion ($19.94 billion) worth of US goods, including steel and dairy products, in a dollar-for-dollar response to President Donald Trump's punitive tariffs on Canadian products.
